title: Affectionate Couple on Apartment Steps, 1950s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-century black-and-white snapshot capturing a smiling, mature couple posing on the curved concrete steps in front of apartment unit #530. The woman is dressed smartly in a tailored skirt suit and patterned blouse, while the man stands casually behind her with his arm resting on her shoulder, wearing high-waisted trousers, a light undershirt, and a casual jacket. The entryway features a multi-panel door with decorative knocker/emblem and casement windows.
